main_text.p: ligione &c. Cùm enim, quando controversia est aliqua fidei orta, seu quæstio de dogmate valdè dubio, sive cujus non notoria est veritas & falsitas ( nam notoriam veritatem non debet pati Magistratus in dubium vocari, nedum ad Synodum pertrahi, sed coërcere contradicentes potestate suâ coactivâ) ordinarius, & verbo Dei maximè conformis modus judicandi sit, qui à Synodis peragitur secundum verbum Dei; Magistratus est non vocari ad Synodum ab Ecclesiasticis, sed convocare Ecclesiasticos ad Synodum aut ipsis petentibus permittere Synodum. Et ubi Ecclesiæ deputatos nominârunt ipsarum est rem referre ad Magistratum, quo ita confirmentur à Magistratu, si is justas causas non videat eos reiiciendi, vide Sibb. p. 149. quemadmodum è contrario poterit excludere personas ab Ecclesiis deputatas, quæ ipsi ob veras & justissimas causas displicent, & mandare Ecclesiis, ut alios

page.notes: Printed text is set in a fairly worn typeface; several words are uncertain and are marked with [?] where marked. The reading "reiiciendi" is probably "rejiciendi" with a hyphenated line-end "reji-". Some letters in "Ecclesiæ" and "Synodum" are blurred by the scan. Line-end hyphens are visible in "pertrahi", "Ecclesiasticos", "reji-ciendi" and similar words. The marginal-free layout means no notes are present. The final word "alios" is set flush right as the last line of the page.
